scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Haha, I have seen many people
but it seems you possess special power and abilities.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
Haha，我阅人无数，而你似乎拥有非凡的力量与本领。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
What brings you here? Is there anything bothering you recently?
Although you're already a Sage, that doesn't mean you can stop studying.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你来这里有什么事？
最近遇到什么烦心事了吗？
虽说你已经是贤者，也不能就此停止学习。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hahah, so my little Novice, what brings you this way? ...I guess you're on a sightseeing trip?
You must have had a really hard time to reach this place. I must say, you seem interested in the Sage class.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
Hahah，小初心者，你怎么到这里来了？
...是来观光的吗？
一路来到这里，想必吃了不少苦吧。
看来你对贤者这个职业很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
*Chuckle* Although we've been studying this world for a long time, I know that studying in itself will fulfill all the needs of the people.
Other classes are just as important to the welfare of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
*Chuckle* 虽然我们研究这个世界已有很长时间，但我知道，学习本身就能满足人们的一切需求。
其他职业对卢恩·米德加兹的福祉也同样重要...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Welcome, young one. I can see that you're intrigued by the wonders of magic.
So what kind of business brings you to me?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
欢迎你，年轻人。
看得出你对魔法的奥秘很感兴趣。
那么，找我有什么事呢？

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You don't seem to be qualified yet.
Remember, you must reach at least job level 40 to become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你似乎还不符合条件。
记住，职业等级至少达到40，才能成为贤者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You possess remaining skill points...
Before you submit your dissertation, please take care this matter first.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你还有未分配的技能点...
提交论文前，请先把技能点分配完。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Ho~ So? Did you finally complete your dissertation? Well done.
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
哦~ 怎么样？
终于完成论文了吗？
做得好。
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hmm? What has happened to you? Where did you leave your dissertation?
Please bring it to me so that you may pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
嗯？
这是怎么回事？
你把论文放哪儿了？
请把论文带来，才能通过考核。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
*Chuckle* Becoming a Sage isn't as simple as you may have assumed.
You cannot become a Sage because your magic skills are inadequate...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
*Chuckle* 成为贤者可没有你想的那么简单。
你的魔法本领还不足以成为贤者...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You'd better leave and increase your reputation.
Never forget that once you also used to be a novice.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你还是先去提升自己的声望吧。
永远别忘了，你也曾是一名初心者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Our knowledge is the mainspring of activity which helps the kingdom to be developed faster.
Please keep this in mind: you must study and record everything you've discovered so that all in the kingdom may benefit.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
我们的知识是推动王国加速发展的动力。
请牢记：你必须不断学习，记录自己的一切发现，让王国的所有人都能从中受益。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
If you aspire to become a Sage, you must first live life as a Mage. Only then shall you have a chance.
I am looking forward seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
如果你立志成为贤者，就得先成为魔法师，积累历练。
只有这样，你才有机会。
期待与你再次相见。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
However, if you happen to meet a Sage down the road, I hope you will lend him your assistance.
And if you do, he shall repay you in kind...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
不过，如果你在旅途中遇到贤者，希望你能伸出援手。
他也会回报你的善意...

scripts.text: I would like to be a Sage.
scripts.translation: 我想成为贤者

scripts.text: Let me know about the Sage job change.
scripts.translation: 了解贤者转职

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hm? Do you wish to become a Sage?
Well then, I would like to suggest a few things that are required of a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
嗯？
你想成为贤者？
那我就先说说成为贤者需要满足哪些条件。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Sages are those who promote the development of this continent through the endless studying and recording of all knowledge related to this world.
Becoming a Sage is more than just a costume change: It's an important job where you must be always aware of your duty and responsibility to the people.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
贤者不断研究并记录这个世界的各种知识，以此推动大陆的发展。
成为贤者，可不只是换一身衣服。
这是一份重要的职责，你必须时刻牢记自己对人民的责任与义务。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You may want to enter an enrollment application to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I believe they can explain in detail what you need to become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你可以向施韦希比尔魔法学院提交入学申请。
他们应该能详细告诉你，成为贤者需要满足哪些条件。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Sage job change...hmm...an interesting turn of phrase, I must say.
Although that is what we say, it is very inappropriate to think of becoming a Sage as merely changing a job.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
贤者转职...嗯...这说法倒有意思。
虽说我们也这样称呼，但把成为贤者仅仅当作换个职业，可就大错特错了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
In order to be a Sage, you must enter an application to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
You will then take the entrance examination.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
要成为贤者，你得先向施韦希比尔魔法学院提交入学申请。
之后再参加入学考试。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
After the examination, you will be assigned to study a specific subject...
and finally, you will submit your dissertation to the university.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
通过考试后，你会被安排研究某个课题...
最后，向学院提交你的论文。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
I am the one who evaluates your dissertation.
When you pass all the courses, you will become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你的论文由我评审。
通过全部课程后，你就能成为贤者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Please visit the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
A young Sage named Metheus Sylphe will accept your application.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
请前往施韦希比尔魔法学院。
那里有位名叫梅修斯·西尔菲的年轻贤者，会受理你的申请。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
I see...Well, seeing as you have leisure time to spare, I encourage you to peruse as many books as you can.
You can find and research every worldly matter within their pages.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
这样啊...既然有闲暇，不妨多读些书。
世间万事万物，都可以在书中探寻、研究。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Ah yes, you can not become the most intelligent person merely by reading all the books around you...
However, for a Sage such as myself, the knowledge found in books is most important.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
当然，就算读遍身边所有的书，也不能让你成为最聪明的人...
不过，对我这样的贤者而言，书中的知识至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Huh...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
咦...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Interesting...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
有意思...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Although it's roughly written, it's well done for a beginner.
Ah yes...you seem to be proficient in studying.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
虽然行文略显粗糙，但作为初学者，已经写得很不错了。
嗯...看来你很善于钻研。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Congratulations! You have now become a Sage.
Always remember to keep a studious and analytical mindset.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
恭喜！
你现在是一名贤者了。
记得始终勤于学习，善于分析。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Also, keep this dissertation and treat it with care, since it is one and only book you have written.
You may have need of it one of these days. And it shall forever remind of this grandiose moment.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
另外，请珍惜并妥善保管这篇论文，毕竟这是你写成的唯一一本书。
也许将来会有用到它的一天。
它也会永远让你铭记这一光荣的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Well then...May God fill your path with knowledge.
Study with diligence!!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
那么...愿神让你的前路充满知识。
勤奋学习吧！！

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Wait...you didn't lose it, did you?
Well...that's your business. It is regrettable that you won't be able to get a chance to write a book anymore.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
等等...你不会把它弄丢了吧？
唉...那是你自己的事。
可惜，你再也没有机会写书了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Study diligently, and return when you finish your dissertation.
Until then, farewell!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
用心钻研，完成论文后再回来吧。
到时再见！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the
Schweicherbil Magic
Academy. W-wait a second...
Do I know you from somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。
等、等一下...
我们是不是在哪儿见过？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh nice to meet you again, long time no see.
So how's it going with the studying?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
哦，又见面了，真高兴。
好久不见，最近学习得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Oh, You're a Mage. How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。
哦，你是魔法师啊。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome, once again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Huh? What are you doing here? You're supposed to be taking the entrance test by now.
Please visit Professor Claytos in the left room.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
咦？
你怎么还在这里？
这会儿你应该在参加入学考试才对。
请去左边的房间找克雷托斯教授。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh, are you done with the dissertation?
Sure, you can submit it to Dean Kayron.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
哦，论文写完了吗？
那就交给凯隆院长吧。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh sorry, this is a rather inconvenient time to converse.
Please come back later. I apologize for troubling you.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
抱歉，现在不太方便交谈。
请稍后再来。
让你白跑一趟，真是不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
We've met before, haven't
we? Oh gosh, I must sound
pretty crazy. I'm sorry, I guess it's because I haven't been
sleeping too well? Oh well,
have a good day, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
我们以前见过，对吧？
天哪，我这话听着一定很莫名其妙。
抱歉，大概是最近没睡好吧？
算了，祝你今天愉快，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
It's okay to study books and magic scrolls all day, 
but you must go outside and fight with monsters as much as you can in order to be a well experienced Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
整天研究书籍和魔法卷轴当然可以，但要成为经验丰富的贤者，还得多出去和魔物实战。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you know any Sage candidates, please give them some advice...
Also, please give my regards to your colleagues as well.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
如果认识准备成为贤者的人，请给他们一些指点...
也请代我向你的同行们问好。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
This place is specialized in Sage class training. Mostly, what we do is study about monsters and magic spells.
We always welcome new students.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
这里专门培养贤者。
我们主要研究魔物与魔法咒语。
随时欢迎新生加入。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
People who are at job jevel 40 as Mage class are qualified to apply for enrollment.
By passing selected courses, we will then approve them as Sages.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
职业等级达到40的魔法师，就有资格申请入学。
通过指定课程后，我们便会认可他们成为贤者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you're interested in the Sage class, please come again.
And have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
如果对贤者这个职业感兴趣，欢迎再来。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
This place is specialized in Sage class training. What we do is study about monsters and magic spells.
People who are at job jevel 40 as Mage class are qualified to apply for enrollment.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
这里专门培养贤者。
我们研究魔物与魔法咒语。
职业等级达到40的魔法师，就有资格申请入学。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you have any Mage friends, please let them know about this academy.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
如果你有魔法师朋友，请向他们介绍这所学院。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text: Let me know about the Sage job change.
scripts.translation: 了解贤者转职

scripts.text: I want to enroll in the school.
scripts.translation: 我想报名入学

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I see. Do you wish to become a Sage?
Unfortunately, we are not in charge of changing your job to the Sage class.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
原来如此。
你想成为贤者？
不过很遗憾，我们并不直接办理贤者转职。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
After you enter this academy and pass certain courses...
you will receive official approval to conduct studies as a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
进入本学院并通过规定的课程后...
你便会获得正式认可，以贤者的身份开展研究。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
For this reason, we do not speak of this proccess as a job change, but as graduation.
Anyway, if you enter your application for this academy, I will inform you about the registration fee and will let you take the test.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
因此，我们不把这个过程称为转职，而是毕业。
总之，提交入学申请后，我会向你说明报名费，并安排你参加考试。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
For your information, if you bring ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000, 
you don't have to pay for the Registration Fee to enroll in the school.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
顺便说一下，如果带来^3355FF古魔法书^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000，就可以免交入学报名费。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
After you register, you will be able to take the entrance test.
If you pass the test, you will write a thesis for a given subject.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
报名后，你就可以参加入学考试。
通过考试后，需要就指定课题撰写论文。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The Dean of the academy will decide whether or not you are qualified.
If you're granted admission, you will be able to join in study and research activities as a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
院长会决定你是否合格。
获得认可后，你就能以贤者的身份参与学习与研究。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
You're always welcome to join us.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
我们随时欢迎你加入。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I see, you want to join the academy. Once again, welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
原来你想入学啊。
再次欢迎你来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
People who have already met the basic requirement by reaching at Mage job level 40 are qualified for enrollment.
A small registration fee will also be required.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
魔法师的职业等级达到40，就满足了入学的基本条件。
此外，还需要缴纳一笔报名费。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The registration fee is 70,000 zeny.
However, if you bring ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000, you will be exempt from this fee.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
报名费为70,000 Zeny。
不过，如果带来^3355FF古魔法书^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000，就可以免交这笔费用。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
So, do you wish to apply immediately?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
那么，要现在申请吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 立即申请

scripts.text: The fee is much too expensive.
scripts.translation: 费用太贵了

scripts.text: I will come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I'm sorry, but you haven't met the basic requirements yet.
Please go study more and reach Mage job level 40 first.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
抱歉，你还不符合基本入学条件。
请继续学习，等魔法师的职业等级达到40再来。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
You have unused skill points left. Please go learn all those skills you've been planning to learn.
We do not accept any ambiguous candidates.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
你还有未分配的技能点。
请先学好你打算学习的技能。
我们不接受目标不明确的申请者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Very well. Let's complete your application form.
Please put your signature here.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
好的，我们来填好申请表吧。
请在这里签名。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Your name is ... {0}. It's a very nice name.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
你的名字是...{0}。
真是个好名字。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh, you've mastered the Mage job! You're great!! *Clap Clap Clap*
In reward for your great effort, you will be exempt from the registration fee!
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
哦，你已经完全掌握魔法师的本领了！
真了不起！！*Clap Clap Clap*
为奖励你的努力，我们将免除你的报名费！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Yes, everything's ready.
Next, you will take an entrance test.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
好了，一切准备就绪。
接下来，请参加入学考试。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Please visit Professor Claytos.
He's in the left room.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
请去找克雷托斯教授。
他在左边的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Will you pay the registration fee with 70,000 zeny?
Or will you give me ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
你要支付70,000 Zeny的报名费，还是交给我^3355FF古魔法书^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000？

scripts.text: Pay 70,000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 支付70,000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Eh? What? Why are you back here?
Do you want to enter the school again?

[克雷托斯·维尔多]
咦？
什么？
你怎么又回来了？
想再入学一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
What are you doing here, kid?
This is a Magic Academy, not a day care center.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
小家伙，你来这里做什么？
这里是魔法学院，不是托儿所。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Well...look who came crawling back. Magic addict.
Yeah yeah, so it's not so bad to be devoted to magic.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
哟...看看是谁又灰溜溜地回来了。
你这个魔法迷。
好啦好啦，痴迷魔法也不是什么坏事。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Hmm... I understand that you want to enter our prestigious academy, but since you chose to live as a different class,
I don't think you can become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
嗯...我理解你想进入我们这所名校，但既然已经选择了别的职业，恐怕就不能成为贤者了。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
What, do you want to be a Sage?
I can tell by your eyes, hungering for wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
怎么，你想成为贤者？
我看得出，你眼里满是对智慧的渴望。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]

I see...did Metheus tell you something?
scripts.translation:

Hah！
你连入学申请都没办完？！
这样啊...梅修斯跟你说了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
You applied for this test already, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。
你已经申请参加这次考试了吧？

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Welcome back.
So, did you study harder this time?
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
欢迎回来。
怎么样，这次有没有认真复习？

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]

You've already passed!
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]

再考一次吗？
你已经通过了！

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]

But I'm not the person handling that part of the test.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
Heh heh，看来你已经写完论文了。
不过，那部分考核不归我负责。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]

Come back later, and I'll spare some time to talk.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
我现在太忙，没空安排笔试。
晚点再来吧，到时我会抽空和你谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Now, I understand how you feel. Since you graduated, you have become a Sage. A Sage...until the end of your days.
So, be strong and independent. Try to explore some places where nobody else has ventured to go.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
我明白你的心情。
既然已经毕业，你就是贤者了。
贤者...直到生命的尽头。
所以，要坚强，也要独立。
去探索那些还无人涉足的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Don't forget to record everything you've experienced.
You must share your knowledge with others by taking excellent notes.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
别忘了记录自己的每一段经历。
做好笔记，把你的知识分享给他人。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Go outside and play with the Porings. That's your job.
Go out, chop chop!!
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
出去和波利玩吧，那才是你该做的事。
快出去，动作快点！！

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
But I hope you remember, no one can live alone.
Although you're strong enough for solo play, you must cooperate and help other people. That's what a Wizard shoud stand for.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
不过，希望你记住，没有人能独自生存。
即使你已经强到能独自冒险，也要与人合作，帮助他人。
这才是巫师应有的风范。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
So, don't go around regretting why you chose a job other than Sage. You'd better go out and hunt, leveling up your current job.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
所以，别总后悔当初没选贤者。
还是出去打怪，提升现在的职业等级吧。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]

Apply for enrollment, and then come again.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
当然，想成为贤者，就得先入学。
办好入学申请，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Do your best. It'll be a good experience for you.
Come again when you finish the application.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
努力吧。
这对你来说会是一次很好的历练。
办完申请再来。

[Claytos Verdo]
You passed the written test.
Go visit Professor Hermes for the practical examination.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
你通过了笔试。
去找赫尔墨斯教授参加实操考试吧。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
But I'll give you another chance to take the written test,
Go study harder and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
不过我会再给你一次参加笔试的机会。
回去好好复习，然后再来。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
But I'll give you another chance,
Go study even harder and come back.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
不过我会再给你一次机会。
回去加倍努力复习，然后再来。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
You will take the written test under the same conditions as the test you took before. I'll give you 20 questions.
Each correct answer will give you 5 points. When your score reaches 80 points, you pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
这次笔试的规则和上次一样。
共20道题，每答对一题得5分。
达到80分，就算通过。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Okay, there's no need to wait.
Answer immediately, or I'll fail you again.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
好了，不用等了。
立刻回答，否则我就再次判你不及格。

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
Go visit Professor Hermes for the practical examination.
Move!
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
去找赫尔墨斯教授参加实操考试。
快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]
submit your thesis to Dean Kayron.
He will decide whether you are qualified to graduate or not.
scripts.translation:
[克雷托斯·维尔多]
把论文交给凯隆院长。
他会决定你是否具备毕业资格。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome. How have you been?
I guess you've been through a lot of hard times...I can tell by your appearance.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
欢迎。
最近过得怎么样？
看你的样子，想必经历了不少艰辛...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Heh heh, now ain't that a cute little Novice?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
Heh heh，这不是个可爱的小初心者吗？

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I am Professor Hermes, in charge of practical examinations.
Are you a candidate for the Sage class?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
我是负责实操考试的赫尔墨斯教授。
你是准备成为贤者的学生吗？

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I am professor Hermes, in charge of practical examinations.
Are you a candidate for the Sage class?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
我是负责实操考试的赫尔墨斯教授。
你是准备成为贤者的学生吗？

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome, you just passed the written test, didn't you?
Now it's time for the practical examination.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
欢迎，你刚通过笔试，对吧？
现在该参加实操考试了。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome again! So, did you fully prepare yourself this time?
Oh well, it's not that hard. Give it your all, okay?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
欢迎回来！
这次准备充分了吗？
其实没那么难，全力以赴就好，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Good job~ Since you passed the practical examination as well...
I'll accept your admission.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
做得好~既然实操考试也通过了...
我就批准你入学。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Huh? Didn't you understand what I said?
I told you to study Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
咦？
你没听懂我的话吗？
我让你去研究天地树。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Huh? Didn't you understand what I said?
I told you to study monsters.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
咦？你没听懂我说的话吗？
我让你去研究魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Huh? Didn't you understand what I said?
I told you to study magic spells that possess certain properties.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
咦？你没听懂我说的话吗？
我让你去研究具有特定属性的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
What are you doing here? Aren't you supposed to be with Dean Kayron?
Oh well, there's no harm in showing me your dissertation though...
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
你怎么还在这里？
不是该去找凯隆院长吗？
不过，让我看看你的论文也无妨...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Oh sorry, I'm quite busy at the moment...
If you have any questions, go visit the professor I've assigned to you.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
抱歉，我现在很忙...
有问题就去找我为你安排的教授。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I know how hard it is to explore all those perilous areas, but it will help you to gain more knowledge.
Book smarts never can beat street smarts.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
我知道探索那些险地并不容易，但这能让你增长见识。
书本知识终究比不上亲身实践。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
However, it's a very dangerous idea to go deep inside a dungeon alone. 
You'd better look for trustworthy comrades.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
不过，独自深入地下城可是很危险的。
最好找些可靠的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
In this continent of Rune-Midgarts, there are a lot of unknown places and objects that haven't been fully discovered.
The monsters, mysterious objects and heroes of myths...
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
卢恩·米德加兹大陆上，还有许多尚未被充分探索的地方和事物。
魔物、神秘的物品，还有神话中的英雄...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Why don't you consider being a Sage in the future?
You will love studying the world.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
不妨考虑将来成为贤者吧？
你会爱上探索这个世界的。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
If by chance you do decide to do that, we'll meet again.
Take care, kiddy.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
如果真有这个打算，我们还会再见的。
保重，小家伙。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
We Sages are more like scholars than Mages.
We are very helpful and powerful as members of a party.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
比起魔法师，我们贤者更像学者。
在队伍中，我们既能发挥强大的力量，也能提供有力的支援。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Try to make a party with a Sage next time.
The wisdom a Sage will bring will be more than helpful for your party...
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
下次试着和贤者组队吧。
贤者的智慧一定能为队伍带来莫大的帮助...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Register your application and take the written test first.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
先办好入学申请，再参加笔试。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Go pass the written test with Professor Claytos first.
Then I will take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
先通过克雷托斯教授的笔试。
之后再由我来考核你。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
There is nothing difficult or special about this test.
All you have to do is kill all the monsters within the time limit.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
这场考试没什么难懂的，也没什么特别之处。
你只需要在规定时间内消灭所有魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
It's better to experience this for yourself, rather than be told about this test 100 times.
How about it? Are you ready to take this test?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
听我讲一百遍，也不如亲自试一次。
怎么样？
准备好参加考试了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 准备好了

scripts.text: Sorry, give me some time.
scripts.translation: 请再给我一点时间

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Good, let's start immediately.
Do your best and come back safely!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
很好，我们马上开始。
全力以赴，平安回来！

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Yes, you don't need to hurry... take your time and come back.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
好，不必着急...
准备好了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 准备好了

scripts.text: Sorry, give me some time.
scripts.translation: 请再给我一点时间

Do your best and come back safely!

全力以赴，平安回来！

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Yes, you don't need to hurry... take your time and come back.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
好，不必着急...
准备好了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Now I need to decide what subject you will learn and study...
Let's see... let me check your written test grade and the time spent on the practical examination.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
现在，我得决定让你研究什么课题...
让我看看...先核对一下你的笔试成绩和实操考试用时。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Hmm, hmm... I see.
Well... I think you're okay.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
嗯，嗯...明白了。
好吧...我觉得你还不错。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Now, you will study Yggdrasil.
Yggdrasil is the tree that was rumored to be the source of life for this world.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
接下来，你将研究天地树。
传说这棵树是这个世界的生命之源。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
That is a good subject which helps us to recognize changes in the world, as well as the direction of its improvement.
Go ask for help from Professor Saphien. He's in the Lecture Room.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
这是个很有意义的课题，能帮助我们了解世界的变化及其发展方向。
去请教萨菲恩教授吧。
他在讲堂里。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I wish you luck.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Now, you will study monsters.
The purpose of this study is to learn and understand more about creatures existing all over the continent.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
接下来，你将研究魔物。
这项研究旨在加深对大陆各地生物的认识与了解。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
This is a good subject which will help you lead your life as a well-experienced Sage.
Go ask for help from Professor Lucius. He's in the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
这是个很有意义的课题，能帮助你成为经验丰富的贤者。
去请教卢修斯教授吧。
他在魔物博物馆。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I wish you luck.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Now, you will study magic skills that have certain properties.
The purpose of this study is to better understand basic magic skills that we use in everyday life.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
接下来，你将研究带有特定属性的魔法。
这项研究旨在加深对日常使用的基础魔法的理解。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
That is a good subject which helps you to deeply understand of the truth of magic.
Go ask Professor Aebecee for help...He's in the Somatology Laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
这是个很有意义的课题，能帮助你深入理解魔法的真谛。
去请教艾贝西教授吧...
他在人体实验室。

I wish you luck.
scripts.translation:

祝你好运。

他在讲堂里。

去请教卢修斯教授吧。
他在魔物博物馆。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
去请教艾贝西教授吧。
他在人体实验室。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
But then again, maybe there is. Go see Dean Kayron.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
不过话说回来，也许还真有。
去找凯隆院长吧。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Do I know you? Were you one of my students?
Oh, it doesn't matter anyway. You wouldn't be a Sage without graduating from this academy...
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
我们认识吗？
你是我的学生？
算了，也不重要。
没从这所学院毕业，你就不可能成为贤者...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
A Novice? Why is a novice here?
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
初心者？
初心者怎么会来这里？

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Welcome, I am in charge of historical studies here in the academy.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
欢迎。
我负责学院的历史研究。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Welcome, {0}. I am glad to meet you.
My name is Saphien Layless, I will be in charge of your class for a while.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
欢迎你，{0}。
很高兴见到你。
我是萨菲恩·莱勒斯，接下来一段时间由我负责你的课程。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
[Saphien Layless]
Oh, did you bring them with you? Excellent!
You brought Yggdrasilberry!
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
哦，东西带来了吗？
很好！
你带来了天地树果实！

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
[Saphien Layless]
Hmm, did you prepare for class? Let's see...
Oh! So you brought me the Yggdrasil Seed?
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
嗯，上课要用的东西准备好了吗？
让我看看...
哦！
你带来了天地树芽？

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
[Saphien Layless]
Hmm, did you prepare for class? Let's see...
Yggdrasil Leaf...
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
嗯，上课要用的东西准备好了吗？
让我看看...
天地树叶子...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
[Saphien Layless]
Huh? You're not ready to this class yet!
I told you to bring me any items related Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
咦？
你还没准备好上课！
我说过，带一件与天地树有关的物品来。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Now, you're writing your thesis.
I will assist you with your writing.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
现在，你要开始写论文了。
我会指导你写作。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I am not sure that you're ready to write a thesis.
I am afraid to say I already informed you of what you need.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
看来你还没准备好写论文。
需要什么，我已经告诉过你了。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Huh? Aren't you supposed to head over to the dean?
If you've finished writing your thesis, please bring it to the dean.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
咦？
你不是该去找院长吗？
论文写完了，就请交给院长。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I am not sure if you have business with me, but please come back later.
I have some issues to think about..
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
不知道你找我有什么事，不过请稍后再来。
我还有些问题要思考...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
In any case, you must study the past in order to better understand the present and to predict...the future.
This sentence contains all the truth of the world.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
无论如何，只有研究过去，才能更好地理解现在，并预测...未来。
这句话蕴含着世间的一切真理。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I guess you're treading the right path...
One of these days you'll look back to this moment and realize it changed your life.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
看来你正走在正确的道路上...
总有一天，回首此刻，你会发现它改变了你的人生。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
One whose life has many possibilities... 
How do you wish to lead your life?
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
你的人生还有无限可能...
你想怎样度过这一生？

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
No matter what you decide to be, everything depends on your choice.
May God bless you so that you can choose the path best for you...
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
无论你想成为什么样的人，一切都取决于自己的选择。
愿神保佑你，找到最适合自己的道路...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The world as we know it is a result of events that described in the records of the ages. It is historical events that have shaped the world as it is today.
Therefore, knowing the past means you will better understand the present and...the future.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
我们熟悉的这个世界，是历代史料中记载的种种事件共同造就的。
正是历史塑造了今天的世界。
因此，了解过去，才能更好地理解现在和...未来。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Reflect upon your past.
You will see your path in the future...
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
回顾自己的过去吧。
你会看清未来的道路...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The subject you're studying is Yggdrasil.
So...do you even know what Yggdrasil is?
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
你的研究课题是天地树。
那么...你知道天地树是什么吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I know very well.
scripts.translation: 很清楚

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Okay then, what is Yggdrasil?
Please answer me.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
好，那天地树是什么？
请回答。

scripts.text: It's a name of a health item.
scripts.translation: 一种恢复物品的名字

scripts.text: It's the source of life in the world.
scripts.translation: 这个世界的生命之源

scripts.text: Suckah, I lied.

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Wrong. {0}, you got - 10 points.
That's just one of the gifts from Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
错了。
{0}，扣10分。
那只是天地树的恩赐之一。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Yggdrasil is the name of the tree that is the source of life in this world.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
天地树，是这个世界生命之源的名字。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
That's right. Yggdrasil, the so-called 'World Tree', 
is the name of the tree that has been the source of life in this world.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
没错。
天地树，又称“世界树”，是这个世界的生命之源。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Great Schott...If you don't know, just say so.
By the way, {0}, you just got - 10 points for lying and for being wrong.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]

我知道不好找，但还是请你尽力找找。

[Saphien Layless]
Tell me when you're ready.
Don't worry about being late, we professors are paid to wait around.

准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The root of this world, Yggdrasil, is a gigantic tree.
It takes root all over the continent of Rune-Midgarts and its leaves reach the sky.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
天地树是支撑着这个世界的巨树。
它的根系遍布卢恩·米德加兹大陆，枝叶直达天空。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Outside of this continent, there is a ocean where a giant snake named Yormungandr is coiled up.
The world as we know it consists of 3 places: Asgard, Midgard and Utgard.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
大陆之外是一片海洋，巨蛇耶梦加得盘踞其中。
我们所知的世界由三部分组成：阿斯加德、米德加尔特和乌特加德。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Utgard is where all the titans live.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
乌特加德是所有巨人居住的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Midgard is where all human beings live.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
米德加尔特是所有人类居住的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
And Asgard is where the gods reside...
An ash tree taking root in the middle of the Rune-Midgarts continent, that is Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
而阿斯加德，是众神居住的地方...
扎根于卢恩·米德加兹大陆中央的那棵白蜡树，就是天地树。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
This continent was born from the heart of Ymir, and Yggdrasil holds the continent together by grasping it with its 3 roots.
These roots stretch into 3 different places.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
这片大陆诞生于尤弥尔的心脏，天地树以三条根系紧紧抓住大陆，使其维系在一起。
这三条根系分别伸向三个地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The first root reaches Asgard where the gods live and 
where we, mere humans, haven't yet explored or experienced.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
第一条根系伸向众神居住的阿斯加德，那是我们凡人尚未涉足的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The second root reaches Jotunnheim where all the giants live.
We've been told this name many times through myths and legends.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
第二条根系伸向巨人居住的约顿海姆。
神话和传说中，常常提到这个名字。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The third one reaches Niflheim.
That place is rumored to be covered with a thick, black fog.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
第三条根系伸向尼芙菲姆。
据说那里笼罩着浓密的黑雾。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Items, such as Seed of Yggdrasil, Yggdrasilbrry and Leaf of Yggdrasil are
considered a part of Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
天地树芽、天地树果实和天地树叶子等物品，都被认为是天地树的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Yggdrasilberry has a fascinating scent that is rumored to
restore full HP and SP at once.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
天地树果实散发着迷人的香气，据说能一次恢复全部HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The seed of Yggdrasil which has the fragrance of a blooming flower and the flavor of nut is rumored to
restore half of HP and SP at once.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
天地树芽有盛放鲜花的香气和坚果的味道，据说能一次恢复一半的HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The leaf of Yggdrasil which is filled with vital force is rumored to
revive the dead, bringing them back to this world.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
天地树叶子充满生命力，据说能让死者复活，重返这个世界。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Lastly... if by some chance you discover a way into Asgard in the future, 
I hope you will find the Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
最后...如果将来你有幸找到通往阿斯加德的道路，希望你能找到天地树。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Even though the story of the Yggdrasil tree only exists in myths and legends, 
we Sages are obligated to discover the truth of the Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
虽说天地树的故事只见于神话和传说，但我们贤者有责任探明它的真相。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
That is the end of today's class.
Please record the articles you've learned today, and try to remember as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
今天的课就到这里。
请记下今天学到的知识，并尽可能牢记。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
In the next class, you will write a thesis about Yggdrasil...
Please bring the following items to prepare for class.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
下节课，你要写一篇关于天地树的论文...
请准备以下物品，供上课使用。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 which will be used for holding the squid ink.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
^3355FF1个鸟羽毛^000000，用作笔
^3355FF1个动物外皮^000000，用作纸张
^3355FF1个玛哪树枝^000000，用于装订书籍
^3355FF1个墨汁^000000，用作墨水
^3355FF1个空瓶^000000，用于盛装墨汁

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I will help you to write your thesis when you're ready with all those items.
I am looking forward to the next class with you.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
备齐这些物品后，我就会指导你撰写论文。
期待下次与你上课。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What is your business with me?
You must make a reservation a week in advance if you have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
找我有什么事？
想请教问题，必须提前一周预约。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What brings you to me, kid?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
小家伙，找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Hmm? What brings you to me? Are you interested in watching monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
嗯？
找我有什么事？
你对观察魔物感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Welcome to my class, did you earn good results in the practical exam?
My name is Lucius Celsus, the expert of Biology.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
欢迎来上我的课。
实操考试成绩不错吧？
我是卢修斯·塞尔苏斯，生物学专家。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You showed great effort to gather all of those.
Well, I am not sure if you gathered them by yourself or bought them from shops...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
收齐这些东西，看来你下了不少功夫。
不过，是自己收集的，还是从商店买来的，我就不知道了...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, you already forgot what I told you just a minute before?
What a nusance... listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么，才一分钟就忘了我说的话？
真麻烦...这次给我仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Well done. So, did you watch insects while gathering those items?
Oh well, I believe you did a good job with the task.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
做得好。
收集这些物品时，有没有观察昆虫？
好吧，我相信你把任务完成得不错。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, you already forgot what I told you?
What a nuisance...listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么，你已经忘了我说的话？
真麻烦...这次给我仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Zzz...Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
Zzz...Zzz...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Hmph. Lucky brat brought all of the items.
Well, I don't expect you to write an outrageously great thesis though...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
哼，你这幸运的小鬼，居然把东西都带齐了。
不过，我可不指望你能写出什么惊世之作...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, are you sure that you're ready? No, I don't think so.
Oh well... listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么，你确定准备好了？
不，我看还没有。
算了...这次给我仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What are you doing here, Go show your thesis to the dean!
Don't wasn't any more time here.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你还在这里干什么？
快把论文交给院长！
别再在这里浪费时间了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Wah~! My brain is gonna blow up soon! Why must I have to prepare all of these things?!
Who are you?! Don't disturb me, I'm busy!!
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
哇~！
我脑子都快炸了！
为什么这些东西全都要我准备？！
你是谁？！
别打扰我，我忙着呢！！

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You don't know how busy person I am...don't you?
If you're a Sage, you're supposed to know about me by now.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你不知道我有多忙，是吧？
既然是贤者，应该早就听说过我了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You have too much time on your hands. Go explore some dungeons.
I think it will be more helpful than wasting your time on me.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你可真闲。
去探索地下城吧。
总比在我这里浪费时间有用。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You'd better go out and play with your pals. 
This is not a place where you can fool around.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
出去和朋友玩吧。
这里不是你胡闹的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You're allowed to watch. However, do not disturb them by making any fuss.
And keep your hands off, some of these guys are way too dangerous to touch.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
看看可以，但别吵吵闹闹地惊扰它们。
也别乱碰，有些家伙可是危险得很。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
By the way, if you catch any rare monsters in future, let me know.
I am willing to purchase those at any cost.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
对了，以后捕到稀有魔物，记得告诉我。
不管花多少钱，我都愿意买。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Huh...how rude of you! You're expected to introduce yourself to me as soon as I greet you!
What is your name, young one?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
哼...真没礼貌！
我一打招呼，你就该自报姓名！
年轻人，你叫什么？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
A fine name. It's nice to meet you.
So, are you aware of the subject you're studying?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
名字不错。
很高兴认识你。
那么，你知道自己要研究什么课题吗？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
As you know, your topic of study is monsters.
How many times have you fought with monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你也知道，自己的研究课题是魔物。
你和魔物战斗过多少次？

scripts.text: Well, I can't even count.
scripts.translation: 多到数不清

scripts.text: A few times, I guess...
scripts.translation: 大概几次吧...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Oh shut up, you brat. Don't be so sure about yourself.
Even if you have much experience with monsters, you will have a hard time comprehending my lecture.
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, that's what I guessed about you. You're just book smart.
However, I am sure you will encounter most of the monsters mentioned in my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
闭嘴，小鬼。
别太自以为是。
就算你与魔物打过不少交道，想听懂我的课也没那么容易。
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
果然不出我所料，你只懂书本上的知识。
不过，我相信你会遇到课上提到的大部分魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, that's what I guessed about you. You're just book smart.
However, I am sure you will encounter most of the monsters mentioned in my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
果然不出我所料，你只懂书本上的知识。
不过，我相信你会遇到课上提到的大部分魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Let's get started.
Make sure you're ready for the practical examination during my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
开始吧。
上课期间还会有实操考核，做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring the following items to me.
5 ^3355FFTentacle^000000,
5 ^3355FFSingle Cell^000000,
5 ^3355FFFish Tail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
去把以下物品带来。
5个^3355FF触手^000000
5个^3355FF单细胞^000000
5个^3355FF鱼尾^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring the following items to me.
5 ^3355FFNipper^000000,
5 ^3355FFClam Flesh^000000,
5 ^3355FFHeart of Mermaid^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
去把以下物品带来。
5个^3355FF钳子^000000
5个^3355FF蛤蜊肉^000000
5个^3355FF美人鱼之心^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring following items to me.
5 ^3355FFTendon^000000,
5 ^3355FFNipper^000000,
5 ^3355FFSharp Scale^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
去把以下物品带来。
5个^3355FF肌腱^000000
5个^3355FF钳子^000000
5个^3355FF锐利麟片^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I will proceed with the class when you bring those to me.
Have fun.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
带来这些东西，我们再继续上课。
玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Somehow the monsters that drop those items have something in common.
Can you tell me what that similarity is?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
掉落这些物品的魔物，有某种共同点。
能告诉我是什么吗？

scripts.text: They possess water property.
scripts.translation: 它们都是水属性

scripts.text: They are fishes.
scripts.translation: 它们都是鱼贝系

scripts.text: They are aggressive.
scripts.translation: 它们会主动攻击

scripts.text: Um...they monsters.
scripts.translation: 呃...它们都是魔物

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, they possess water property and at the same time they are fishes.
Most fish class monsters live underwater, so they are attributed with the water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
没错，它们既是水属性，也是鱼贝系魔物。
大多数鱼贝系魔物生活在水下，因此属于水属性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, they possess water property and at the same time they are fishes.
Most fish class monsters live underwater, so they are attributed with the water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
没错，它们既是水属性，也是鱼贝系魔物。
大多数鱼贝系魔物生活在水下，因此属于水属性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
...I didn't know Phens were aggressive nowadays?
Or do Marina and Plankton team up to start a fight with you?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
...剑鱼什么时候也会主动攻击了？
还是水母和漂浮虫联手找你打架？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
All the monsters from which you obtained these items are not agressive... get a grip.
They are all fishes and possess water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
掉落这些物品的魔物，全都不会主动攻击...清醒点。
它们都是水属性的鱼贝系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What...! What are you here for!? You are here to study about specific monsters, microcephalic moron!
Sigh...they are all fishes and possess water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么...！
你到底来干什么的！？
你是来研究特定魔物的，没脑子的蠢货！
Sigh...它们都是水属性的鱼贝系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Not all fish class monsters possess water property, but most of them do.
So which kind of magic would work best on most fish class monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
鱼贝系魔物并非全是水属性，但大多数是。
那么，对付大多数鱼贝系魔物，哪种魔法最有效？

scripts.text: Lightening Bolt.
scripts.translation: 雷击术

scripts.text: Fire Bolt.
scripts.translation: 火箭术

scripts.text: Thunder Storm.
scripts.translation: 雷暴术

scripts.text: Frost Diver.
scripts.translation: 冰锥术

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
That's right, Lightening Bolt, which possesses the wind property, works best on water property monsters.
Although you might want to be careful of monsters that recognize magic casting.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
没错，雷击术是风属性魔法，对水属性魔物最有效。
不过，要小心那些会对施法作出反应的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What? Fire Bolt! Fire cannot beat water, you imbecile!
Most fishes are attributed with the water property. Therefore, they are weak to wind property magic spells. Don't you get it?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么？
火箭术！
火可克不了水，蠢货！
大多数鱼贝系魔物都是水属性，因此怕风属性魔法。
还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yeah, Thunder Storm spell is fine... it's a wind property spell.
However, you will be in trouble if you use the spell in a poorly chosen spot.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
嗯，雷暴术也可以...它也是风属性魔法。
不过，施放位置没选好，可就麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I can't fathom such stupidity! This question asks you to choose a property that counters water! Don't you get it?
Logically, any magic spell possessing the water property cannot overcome the water atrribute monsters!
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
怎么会这么蠢！
题目要你选能克制水属性的魔法，明白吗？
想想就知道，水属性魔法怎么能克制水属性魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
By the way, although some monsters such as Penomena or Aster are considered to be fish class monsters, 
they have a different property than the others. You'd better be careful with them.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
对了，梅纳海葵、海星这些魔物虽属鱼贝系，属性却与其他魔物不同。
对付它们时要多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Okay, let me teach you about insect monsters.
Let's see... hmm... hmm...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
好，接下来讲昆虫系魔物。
让我看看...嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

带来这些东西，我们再继续上课。
玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Insect class monsters do not share the same property most of the time, 
You must think twice before you cast a magic spell on an insect.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
昆虫系魔物的属性往往各不相同。
对它们施放魔法前，得先想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
It's remarkable that insects can detect hidden objects.
Therefore, any hiding skill such as the Hiding skill or Cloaking skill will not work on insect monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
昆虫能察觉隐藏的事物，这一点很厉害。
因此，隐匿、伪装之类的隐藏技能，对昆虫系魔物都无效。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Some insects form a group and live together.
They are controlled by the head of the group...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
有些昆虫群居生活。
它们受群体首领的支配...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
For instance, Maya the queen ant...
Mistress, the queen of hornets,
or Golden Thiefbug, the king of thiefbugs...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
比如蚁群的女王蚁后...
黄蜂的女王蜂后，
还有盗虫之王黄金虫...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You cannot beat those boss monsters alone, 
you'd better form a party if you want to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
这些首领魔物，靠你一个人可打不过。
想挑战它们，最好先组队。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
That's the end of my class...it's time for you to write a thesis.
Bring me following items for writing the thesis.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
课就上到这里...接下来该写论文了。
把以下写论文要用的物品带来。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 which will be used for holding squid ink.
scripts.translation:

^3355FF1个鸟羽毛^000000，用作笔
^3355FF1个动物外皮^000000，用作纸张

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I will help you in writing the thesis when you bring all of those items.
You're almost there. Isn't learning easy?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
东西带齐，我就指导你写论文。
马上就完成了。
学习是不是很简单？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Well, if you really want to write it by yourself, I can let you handle it but...
I will give you a work of staggering genius. Just make a copy of it under your name.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你真想自己写，我也可以让你来，不过...
我会给你一篇才华横溢的杰作。
照抄一份，署上你的名字就行。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You got a problem with that? Tough, that's my style.
Just do what I say.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
有意见？
忍着，这就是我的风格。
照我说的做。

scripts.translation:

写完了？
好，那就到这里。
你再也没有重写论文的机会，好好保管。

再见。

你一直做得不错，这件事应该难不倒你。
快去把东西拿来。

scripts.translation:

看来你闲得很。
好，我给你安排点任务。
Hahaha，不愿意？
行，那就滚吧。

If you just want to watch monsters here, fine with me...
Just don't ask me any questions.
scripts.translation:

只是在这里看看魔物，倒也无妨...
别问我问题就行。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你好~？

是来看我的吗？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

东西没带齐？

scripts.translation:

Tee hee~

scripts.text:

Oh~ how sweet! You brought some Holy Water~ thanks honey~

scripts.translation:

哦~真贴心！
带来圣水了~谢谢，亲爱的~
好啦，该上课了。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, precious...are you playing games? Tee hee.

scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
宝贝，怎么还在这里...跟我闹着玩呢？
Tee hee。
哦，可怜的孩子。
已经忘了我的话吗？
要我提醒一下？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

别紧张，你一定没问题~

[Aebecee George]

scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
甜心，怎么还在这里？
Tee hee~
哦，可怜的孩子。
已经忘了我的话吗？
要我提醒一下？
没问题，tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]

scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
亲爱的，怎么还在这里？
不去找院长，让他看看你的成果吗？
听我的，像他那样的男孩子，可不会一直等你哦，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well well...what do we have here?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哎呀呀...这是谁来了？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh well, although you have become a Sage, you're just doing the same thing, tee hee...we're mages down to the core!
We're way better than any other class because we're pretty good with our heads, you know?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
虽说成了贤者，做的还是老本行，tee hee...我们骨子里都是魔法师！
我们头脑聪明，所以比其他职业都厉害，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay, is there anything you want to talk about?
Oh dearie, don't be nervous...where's your sense of adventure?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
好啦，有什么想聊的吗？
亲爱的，别紧张...你的冒险精神呢？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, sweetcakes? Do you just come over to see what's in here?
Do you want some candy? Candy, my precious? Tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
甜心，来做什么呀？
只是来看看这里有什么吗？
想吃糖吗？
宝贝，要糖吗？
Tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh gosh...Sorry, I thought I had some...
But I've got other treats, you catch my drift?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哎呀...抱歉，我还以为有糖呢...
不过，我还有别的好东西招待你，懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Did you come here to look around? Huh...?
Well, if you're not here for business, you must be here...
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
是来参观的吗？
嗯...？
既然不是来办正事，那一定是来...

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
...for PLEASURE.
Hey wait! Come back~!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
...找乐子的。
嘿，等等！
回来~！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, I am the Professor in charge of you, Abecee George.
So...aren't you happy to be with me, dearie? Aren't you gay? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
Tee hee，我是指导你的教授，艾贝西·乔治。
亲爱的...和我在一起不开心吗？
不快乐吗？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
However, before we get start class, I need you to do me...a favor.
Don't be scared, its just an eensy weensy favor. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
不过，上课前得请你帮我...一个忙。
别怕，只是个小小的忙。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Please bring me ^3355FF30 Stone^000000, that's all.
It's not so hard, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
只要带来^3355FF30个宝石原石^000000就好。
不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Why don't you ask a thief pal for help?
We'll start the class when you bring me those stones~ Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
不妨找个盗贼朋友帮忙？
把宝石原石带来，我们就开始上课~Tee hee~

scripts.text:

Hocus-focus!!
scripts.translation:

Hocus-focus!!

Hocus~focus!!

Hocus~focus!!

Ho~cus~fo~cus!!
scripts.translation:

Ho~cus~fo~cus!!

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, you naughty stone~
Only 3 of them worked for me. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
Tee hee，调皮的石头们~
只有3个成功了呢。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Here's my other favor to ask of you. Oh, are those tears of...joy?
Oh, I'm sooo excited too! Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
还得请你帮个忙。
哦，流泪了...喜极而泣吗？
我也好~兴奋！
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I will give you these elemental ores...but...they are not for free.
Whoa there cowboy! Don't pull out so soon~ Listen, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
这些元素矿石给你...不过...可不是白送的。
别急，牛仔！
别这么快就走嘛~听我说，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Please make arrows using these items and bring them to me, pretty please~
50 ^3355FFCrystal Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFStone Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFWind Arrow^000000.

[艾贝西·乔治]
请用这些材料制作箭矢，再带给我，拜托啦~
50支^3355FF水灵箭矢^000000
50支^3355FF地灵箭矢^000000
50支^3355FF风灵箭矢^000000

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Ask any of your Archer friends if you know any.
I am looking forward to seeing you again, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
有认识的弓箭手朋友，就请他们帮忙吧。
期待再见到你，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I asked you to bring ^3355FF30 Stone^000000.
There are many out there, so you won't have too hard a time getting them~ tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
我让你带来^3355FF30个宝石原石^000000。
外面多得很，找起来应该不难~tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I'll say something, and you just write everything down.
Don't forget to underline the important sentences~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
我说，你记，把内容全记下来。
重要的句子，别忘了画上下划线~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Water property magic is sooo strong against the fire property.
Just remember those burly, sexay fire fighters, shall we say, putting out that fire with water. Ooh, wet!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
水属性魔法对火属性可强~了。
想想那些魁梧又性感的消防员，用水把火扑灭。
哦，湿漉漉的！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Wind property magic totally dominates the water property! Oh, yes~
Think of a hot flash, and by that I mean ligntening, striking a lake. Oh, I'm bad!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
风属性魔法完全压制水属性！
哦，没错~
想想那道炽热的闪光——我说的是闪电——击中湖面的情景。
哦，我真坏！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
In terms of strength, magic with earth property goes on top of wind property magic! Ho~~
Just think of how the wind passionately beats against the cliffside near the Lookout Point or Lover's Lane. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
论威力，地属性魔法可是压在风属性魔法上面的！
Ho~~
想想瞭望点或情人小径附近，风如何热烈地拍打悬崖。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with fire property is strong against earth property! Tee hee~
Just think of burning wood, sprung from the earth, in a cozy fireplace. On the bearskin, in the dark~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
火属性魔法克制地属性！
Tee hee~
想想生长于大地的木材，在温暖的壁炉里燃烧。
在熊皮上，在黑暗中~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
...Oh my gosh! Time flies sooo fast!
Let's call it a day, dear, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
...天哪！
时间过得好~快！
亲爱的，今天就到这里吧，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
When you come to the next class, bring ^3355FF1 Holy Water^000000~
I hope you have at least one Priest friend. Oh, you don't? Well, it couldn't hurt to get friendly with one.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
下次上课，带来^3355FF1瓶圣水^000000~
希望你至少认识一位牧师。
哦，不认识？
那就交个牧师朋友嘛。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
50 ^3355FFCrystal Arrow^000000,

Even if you don't understand, just pretend and go with the flow, alright? Tee hee~

[艾贝西·乔治]
和上次一样，我说什么，你就全部记下来。
听不懂也装作听懂，顺着我来，好吗？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Water Magic is weak against wind property! Yes, that's right~
Just remember why you don't keep the electric fan around when you're taking a hot bubble bath. Ooh! So electric!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
水属性魔法不擅长对付风属性！
没错~
想想泡热水泡泡浴时，为什么不能把电风扇放在旁边。
哦！
真来电！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with the wind property is weak against earth property!
Think of how the wind can't, shall we say, penetrate a mud facial mask~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
风属性魔法不擅长对付地属性！
想想风怎么也穿不透泥面膜~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with earth property is weak against fire property! Tee hee~
Just think of burning wood, sprung from the earth, in a cozy fireplace. On the be--oh? I said that already? Oh poopy.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
地属性魔法不擅长对付火属性！
Tee hee~
想想生长于大地的木材，在温暖的壁炉里燃烧。
在熊——哦？
说过了？
哎呀，真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with fire property is weak against water property! Yes~
When things get flaming hot, it's best to splash things in cold water. Don't you agree~?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
火属性魔法不擅长对付水属性！
没错~
热得像着火一样时，最好泼点冷水。
你说是不是~？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh, it's the end of the class~ tee hee.
So? Do you think you've learned a lot? You can thank me, honey!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哦，下课了~tee hee。
怎么样？
是不是学到了很多？
亲爱的，可以好好感谢我啦！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well, that's it. You can write your thesis with what I've taught you!
Tee hee~ yes! Yes! I am the best teacher in the world! Oh, I am on fire! Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
好啦，就这样。
用我教你的知识写论文吧！
Tee hee~没错！
没错！
我是世上最棒的老师！
哦，我真是状态火热！
Tee hee~

scripts.text:

Okay, please gather these items so you can write the thesis, dear~ Tee hee~
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,

亲爱的，收齐这些物品，就能写论文了~Tee hee~
^3355FF1个鸟羽毛^000000，用作笔
^3355FF1个动物外皮^000000，用作纸张

So get on out there cowboy and hurry back~ Tee hee~
scripts.translation:

快去吧，牛仔，早去早回~Tee hee~

[Test Helper]
Welcome to the Sage practical examination hall.
If you wish to take the test right now, please enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[考试助手]
欢迎来到贤者实操考场。
想现在参加考试，就请进入候考室。

scripts.text:
[Test Helper]
If someone is currently taking the test, please wait until that person finishes.
The progression of the test is announced on the entire map. An announcement will be made when the next person is ready to leave the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[考试助手]
如果有人正在考试，请等对方考完。
考试进度会在整张地图广播。
轮到下一位考生离开候考室时，也会发布通知。

scripts.text:

The Test takes 5 ~ 10 minutes per each person.
If you wish to leave the arena, please log out from the game.
